description: AWS IAM policy security check — Offline audit of an AWS IAM identity, resource or trust policy (JSON). Flags full admin (Action * / Resource *), service-wide wildcards (iam:*, kms:*), Allow+NotAction/NotResource, privilege-escalation actions (CreatePolicyVersion, Attach/Put*Policy, CreateAccessKey, UpdateAssumeRolePolicy...), iam:PassRole on * with compute-creation combos, sensitive data actions on *, public Principal * without Condition, OIDC web-identity trust with no :sub condition, cross-account principals, duplicate Sids, old Version and size limits. Verdict PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK with score, grade and fixes. Params: policy= (JSON; also accepts get-policy-version / get-account-authorization-details wrappers and URL-encoded documents) or url= (raw or GitHub blob). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_iam_policy
